title: great app, no charging of any kind!
body: i really love this app, but one thing i would ask is if you guys could make the app icon color changeable! Like being able to change it to a white color with a blue or pink (or any pretty color) as the ring on the inside:) this isn’t a criticism, i just hide the app because it doesn’t fit with my other apps and wallpaper and would loove to be able to open it right as i’m on my home screen 😭
author: Dannii HWC

title: Love the simplicity - very on point
body:
Great app that gets to point of simply aiding me in setting up my implementation intentions, reminders and tracking with out too much fuss and settings.

Great job!
author: Ludvig8370

title: Enkelt lækkert design & stærkt mentalt værktøj
body:
Fantastisk app med lækkert enkelt design. Rig mulighed for at customize sine mål og reflektere gennem noter. Og så den helt og aldeles gratis🌼

Stor anbefaling herfra🫶🏼
